regime.instructions: Which market regime best describes AERO right now? State is a compact numeric snapshot of the AERO-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Optically 3x price/holders-revenue after the Aerodrome+Velodrome merger into Aero (October 2026). Bear case: Holders revenue includes bribes paid to direct emissions, so part of it is incentive-driven, not organic; 36% float; price -44% in 30 days; thin liquidity ($14M per day).

criteria.trending: Persistent directional move: returns over 1h and 4h share a sign and vol is normal for this asset.
criteria.mean_reverting: Range-bound: short-term moves fade, returns flip sign, vol at or below its 24h level.
criteria.high_vol: Volatility well above its 24h level (vol.ratio high) without disorderly market structure.
criteria.crisis: Disorderly: large 24h drawdown, very high vol, wide spreads or thin depth, one-sided flow, market-wide stress.

direction.instructions: Which direction for AERO has the better expected result over the next ~4 hours after ~15 bps of costs? State is a compact numeric snapshot of the AERO-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Optically 3x price/holders-revenue after the Aerodrome+Velodrome merger into Aero (October 2026). Bear case: Holders revenue includes bribes paid to direct emissions, so part of it is incentive-driven, not organic; 36% float; price -44% in 30 days; thin liquidity ($14M per day).

criteria.long: Rises: bribe and fee income holds while selling exhausts.
criteria.short: Falls: emissions dilution and falling bribes in risk-off; thin book amplifies moves.
criteria.neutral: No edge after costs, signals conflict, or the move has already happened.

toxic_flow.instructions: Recent AERO order flow looks informed or one-sided enough that a position opened now would likely be adversely selected (sweeps through levels, sudden spread widening, trade bursts against the resting book).

setup_quality.instructions: How good is the trade setup for AERO right now? State is a compact numeric snapshot of the AERO-USDT-SWAP perpetual: order book (px), returns in bps (ret_bps), realized vol (vol), trade flow (flow), our position (pos), fundamentals (fund) and market context (mkt). Thesis: Optically 3x price/holders-revenue after the Aerodrome+Velodrome merger into Aero (October 2026). Bear case: Holders revenue includes bribes paid to direct emissions, so part of it is incentive-driven, not organic; 36% float; price -44% in 30 days; thin liquidity ($14M per day).
criteria: No setup: conflicting signals, thin or unstable book, or the move already happened.
Weak: one supporting signal, others neutral or mixed.
Good: price action, order flow and fundamentals agree on direction; liquidity is adequate.
Excellent: strong agreement across flow, regime and fundamentals, tight spread, no conflicting risk.

risk_state.instructions: Given our position, drawdown and daily P&L in pos, what is the risk state for AERO?

criteria.safe: Comfortable room: small inventory, shallow drawdown, daily P&L not near a loss limit.
criteria.near_limit: Drawdown, daily loss or inventory is approaching the levels where we would have to cut.
criteria.reduce: Exposure should be cut now: losses accelerating or inventory too large for current conditions.
